name: Sao Jose dos Campos
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: São José dos Campos’ official municipal geoprocessing service links its GeoSanja municipal geographic database and registered-lot maps. The city describes GeoSanja as a municipal spatial-data portal with map and download services. These sources establish city-specific municipal map/cadastral activity, but this review did not verify an anonymous full-polygon feature response for the WUP point.
